newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO IN STIRRING SUPER 12 VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-OTAGO IN STIRRING SUPER 12 VICTORY.

text.p: The Otago Highlanders dug deep to chalk up their second win in the Super 12 series on Saturday after an inauspicious start against the Canterbury Crusaders in Dunedin.
The Crusaders ran up a 17-0 lead in only eight minutes, leaving the Highlanders looking set to remain at the bottom of the competition points' table.
The home side were shocked by two quick tries by the Crusaders through full-back Leon MacDonald and winger Daryl Lilley, but the Highlanders fought back to win 37-29.
Tony Brown, who kicked 21 of the Highlanders' points including a 79th minute drop-goal, began the recovery with three penalties to close the gap to 17-9.
Fijian sevens star Manasa Bari then scored a fine try, which Brown converted, to narrow the gap to 16-17.
Otago's persistent forward pressure paid dividends when they scored a pushover try touched down by hooker Anton Oliver to put them into the lead for the first time at 23-20.
Just seconds from the interval Bari snatched up a loose ball during a Canterbury attack and raced 70 metres for a magnificent try which gave Otago a 28-20 lead.

A succession of penalties from both sides saw Crusaders close the gap to 34-29 and throw everything into the attack. But Brown finally made it safe for the Highlanders with a drop goal a minute before the final whistle.

Otago Highlanders - Matthew Carrington, Jeff Wilson, Romi Ropati, Manasa Bari, To'o Vaega, Tony Brown, Stu Forster, Taine Randell (captain), Kupu Vanisi, Isitolo Maka, John Blaikie, Steve Gordon, Carl Hoeft, Anton Oliver, Nick Moore.

Canterbury Crusaders - Leon MacDonald, Daryl Lilley, Milton Going, Daryl Gibson, Mark Mayerhofler, Andrew Mehrtens, Justin Marshall, Clark McLeod, Angus Gardiner, Todd Blackadder (captain), Norman Maxwell, Mark Weedon, Kevin Nepia, Mark Hammett, Con Barrell.
